svg.title: Understanding users to improve human–AI interactions
svg.desc: Original right-hand diagrams from B1 Figure 1. Decoding and user simulation connect psychological knowledge to chatbot interactions. The lower panel illustrates targeted simulations and a proposed shift towards more helpful interactions.

g.title: Illustrative human portrait: studies provide mental-state assessments and observed behavior.
Illustrative user simulator, trained and tested against independent human behavior.
Chatbot participating in human studies and simulated conversations.
A shared blue fork connects Broader simulation to its two illustrative profile clusters; these links are not conversation trajectories.

Two Gaussian blue clouds illustrate additional simulated user-state/situation profiles, with dense centers and naturally sparse tails. Dark and light blue distinguish profiles, not confidence or before/after outcomes. These are schematic examples, not measured or predicted PCA scores. Original observations are drawn above the illustrative clouds. Greater psychological coverage need not imply a larger two-dimensional PCA area.
Illustrative user-state/situation profile-1; not observed data.
Illustrative user-state/situation profile-2; not observed data.
